badge.$description: Non-interactive display pill — the sportsbook's status/label chips (live, freebet, postponed, bet statuses, expiry, generic tags). One axis on top of size: 'role' (5 semantic states — neutral/active/positive/negative/warning), each in 'tint' (12% wash + coloured text, the common label look) or 'solid' (saturated fill + contrasting text). Reworked from the old decorative 10-hue 'tag' version: sportsbook labels carry meaning, so Badge is driven by the semantic role/label/status colours, not arbitrary hues. Bet-settlement statuses and named labels (live/freebet/…) are shown on the docs page as applications of these roles + the label/betStatus semantic colours, not as extra token structure. Split deliberately from Chip (the interactive filter-toggle) — display pill vs. checkbox-like toggle are different ARIA roles.

size.$description: Height/paddingX/label ladder mirrors Counter's own sm/base/lg so the two small-pill components line up at identical heights in a row.

role.$description: 6 semantic states. 'neutral' uses the raised surface (no coloured wash) with secondary/default text. Solid text is dark on the BRIGHT fills — active/warning (text.forActiveBg) and accent (text.contrast; white on the #31A8FF accent only scores 2.6:1, dark scores 7.2:1) — and white (text.onFill) on the darker fills (positive/negative). This per-fill choice is the text.forLabelBg problem a future token will formalise; verify any new solid role's text contrast (≥4.5:1) before white-by-default.

named.$description: Named product labels — first-class named badges that are specific applications of the tint colours (given their own class + display label so they read as a fixed vocabulary, not an arbitrary role choice). live & betbuilder = the active tint (active text on a 12% active wash); freebet = the accent tint (accent text on a 12% accent wash); score = a surface-6 chip with white text (label.score — the sanctioned surface-6-as-background). betbuilder/freebet display the short BB/FB inline; the docs also show the full word for the rare place it fits.

betStatus.$description: My Bets settlement badges — always SOLID, filled with the betStatus.* colour. Text is dark (text.contrast) on the bright win/cashout fills and white (text.onFill) on the rest — the per-fill label-text choice that a future text.forLabelBg will formalise; per-status for now. Mirrors the seven betStatus semantic roles (win/loose/cashout = positive/negative/warning; halfWin/halfLoose/refund/pending = the file-only status color-4..7).
